description: Estamos formando un equipo interdisciplinario para aplicar ciencia de datos y observación satelital a retos ambientales andinos. Nuestro reto es crear una app que armonice focos MODIS y VIIRS y muestre patrones históricos de incendios en ecosistemas de alta montaña, siendo la región Áncash el caso de estudio piloto. Buscamos integrantes con interés o experiencia en Python, SIG/teledetección, gestión y visualización de datos, diseño y comunicación. Valoramos la colaboración y el rigor científico.
summary:
ANDES VIGÍA is a technological prototype designed to monitor and analyze wildfire activity in Carhuaz, Ancash, Peru. It uses NASA FIRMS satellite data from MODIS and VIIRS sensors to collect historical active-fire observations, identify their geographical distribution, and organize information for temporal and spatial analysis.

Our goal is to transform complex satellite data into accessible information that can support local awareness, wildfire monitoring, and prevention efforts.
details:
ANDES VIGÍA is a Python-based prototype that uses NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) to collect and process satellite active-fire observations.

The system integrates data from MODIS and VIIRS satellite instruments, including Suomi-NPP, NOAA-20, and NOAA-21. The information is organized into historical CSV files and processed to identify fire detections within the defined Carhuaz study area.

The processing workflow is designed to organize detections, evaluate data quality, compare satellite observations, and generate temporal summaries.

The project aims to make satellite-based fire information easier to understand and use, helping local stakeholders improve wildfire awareness and support prevention and territorial monitoring.

Development tools include Python, the NASA FIRMS API, Pandas, Requests, and Visual Studio Code.
